en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham Bin Salim, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘

I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying that: ‘In the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup>, when the man is seized being with the boy in one quilt, both naked, the man would be struck (whipped), and the boy be disciplined. And if he has penetrated and was married, would be stoned’.
